court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: T.Sivakumar vs The Inspector Of Police

parties.respondent_defendant: The Inspector of Police, Thiruvallur Town Police Station, and others

facts_of_case: Petitioner's minor daughter Sujatha was kidnapped by respondents. Petitioner filed habeas corpus petition to secure her custody.

legal_principles.principle: A special law will have an overriding effect over a general law to the extent of any inconsistency between them.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, being a special law, will have overriding effect over the Hindu Marriage Act to the extent of any inconsistency between these two enactments.
applicable_acts_sections: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act — Section X
cited_cases: T.Sivakumar vs The Inspector Of Police, (2011) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to override a general law with a special law.
legal_principles.held: In view of the said settled position, undoubtedly, Section 3 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act will have overriding effect over the Hindu Marriage Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act — Section X
cited_cases: T.Sivakumar vs The Inspector Of Police, (2011) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Court directed Inspector of Police to secure the petitioner's minor daughter and produce her before the court.

use_for_drafting: representing parents in family law matters
